title: Star Sign
tagline: With ERC6551 tokenbound implementation on chiliz for contributing the chiliz ecosystem via the nft's by giving them interesting utilities. Only players will be able to mint their own signature, and they can sell it, or just give it to someone like a donation.
description:
we use ERC6551 tokenbound implementation on chiliz for contributing the chiliz ecosystem with dapps on top of it via the nft's by giving them interesting utilities. In the future there will be a seperate dashboard for the users and the players and only players will be able to mint their own signature, and they can sell it, or just give it to someone like a donation.
There could be many utilities of these collections such as a with giveaway sports lovers met with their favourite players. By holding tokens in their tokenbound NFT's they can increase their chances to win the giveaway. Another utility can be a in game one. For example users can create team of players with their tokenbound NFT's and play games with them. Also locking their tokens to their NFT's they can strengthen their team and increase their winning possibility.
how_its_made: we have used ERC-6551 tokenbound account implementation on chiliz spicy testnet for contributing the chiliz ecosystem with dapps on top of it via the nft's by giving them interesting utilities.  Looking ahead, a dedicated dashboard will differentiate between user and player privileges, allowing exclusive minting for players to trade or donate signature NFTs. We used thirdweb to deploy jersey and signature nft collection contracts and remix for deploying ERC6551Registry and ERC6551Account implementation contracts. ERC6551Account is for the tokenbound implementation and can be customized such as adding a any kind of token receiving capability to NFT's.
